g.text: Power-up: BIOS 2.4 boots (20×4 LCD, ANSI welcome on the UART terminal, melody, LEDs)
Menu 3: LED animations (U7 bar graphs) driven by the 8253's IRQ0
Menu 1: the BIOS reads the SD card (bit-banged SPI) and lists the .IMG images
DIR typed on the PS/2 keyboard: real PS/2 frames, 8259 IRQ1, echo on the UART
Pin hover: net, logic level and highlighted traces (U1.37 = A17)
DSO-804 oscilloscope: keyboard clock and data, IRQ1, INTR; PS/2 frames decoded
J12: free 8259 inputs (IR2, IR3, IR5-IR7); IR2 enabled, right-click: Trigger
Edge on J12.2: the 8088 acknowledges the interrupt — "INT 0Ah Triggered"
32-channel logic analyzer: 8088 bus (A0-A19, D0-D7, ALE, RD, WR, IO/M) decoded
Zoom down to the clock cycle: MR/MW/IOR/IOW, address and data
"Data bus" preset: ASCII decoder; configurable UART, SPI, I²C and PS/2 decoders
